**1 — Scene:** A small spinach-based vegetable salad with a thick round of corn on the cob and a little broccoli.

**2 — Vessel:** Rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using the requested circular approximation: **3.14 × 13² = 531 cm²**. Food on the left-hand plate is excluded.

**3 — Items:** Spinach leaves and stems, corn, broccoli, small pale onion-like pieces, and a few yellow/red vegetable pieces. A slight sheen suggests a little dressing, though its amount is uncertain.

**4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy:** Areas below allocate the visible footprint without double-counting overlapping foods.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Spinach | 32% | 170 × 3 = 510 ml | 0.15 | 77 | 23 | 18 |
| Corn round, edible portion | 6% | 32 × 1.8 = 58 ml | 0.65 | 38 | 96 | 36 |
| Broccoli | 3% | 16 × 2 = 32 ml | 0.60 | 19 | 35 | 7 |
| Onion-like pieces | 1% | 5.3 × 0.8 = 4.2 ml | 0.60 | 3 | 40 | 1 |
| Yellow/red vegetable pieces | 1% | 5.3 × 1.2 = 6.4 ml | 0.60 | 4 | 35 | 1 |
| Possible oil dressing | Overlays vegetables | Thin coating, about 3 ml | 0.92 | 3 | 884 | 27 |

The food footprints total **43% of the plate**, consistent with the largely empty left half. The corn weight estimates edible food, not the central cob.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **144 g and 90 kcal** is plausible for this modest, mostly leafy portion. Dressing is the largest energy uncertainty; without oil, the estimate would be about 63 kcal.
